Site Specific Conditions: 1. By January 15, the licence holder must submit to the Department, all revisions to the facility-specific proprietary HMSOPs referenced in the fish health management plan (Attachment I), with modified sections identified, or inform the Department if no changes to HMSOPs. 2. By September 15, 2024, the licence holder must provide evidence (site drawings and/or plans and written SOP) that they have implemented the following mitigation measures to enable the isolation of fish populations to control disease spread in the event of an Infectious Hematopoietic Necrosis virus (IHNv) outbreak. Specifically this means a) water systems must be independent by species; b) effluent can be contained to prevent disease from spreading outside the facility to impact wild fish populations in the event of an outbreak; and c) physical infrastructure barriers, strong biosecurity protocols, and associated staff training are put into place to address these concerns. 3. The licence holder must retain a copy of the facility-specific proprietary HMSOPs at the facility to be made available for review by a fishery officer or fishery guardian upon request. 4. The licence holder shall only release salmon cultured at this facility into the following locations: Penticton Canal (Shingle Creek); the Okanagan River below (south) of Okanagan Falls Dam; and/or Osoyoos Lake. Any release above (north) of the Okanagan Lake Dam / Penticton Dam is not permitted under this licence. 5. The licence holder shall maintain an annual program to assess potential impacts of hatchery-origin fish on wild-origin sockeye salmon and kokanee within freshwater habitats serving as receiving and rearing areas. 6. All releases of S1 salmon from this facility must receive a separate authorization by the BC Introductions and Transfers Committee. S1 salmon is defined as salmon smolts that are physiologically adapted for transition from freshwater to seawater in the spring after one summer spent in freshwater. 7. All other releases of salmon stocks not referenced in site specific condition 6 may be released in accordance with the conditions of licence (Section 6. Release of Fish) provided that; in the past 90 days, there has not been any suspected or active disease occurrence within the facility that required veterinary intervention.
